message: The other night, my husband and I were enjoying our usual evening routine when—surprise!—the power went out. I had just mentioned earlier in the week that we should charge our power banks and check our flashlights. As he fumbled around looking for candles, I couldn't help but wear a little smug smile. We ended up cozying up with our lanterns and phones, sharing stories and laughter. Who knew a blackout could be such a bonding experience? So, have you ever had a moment where your preparedness paid off? I'd love to hear your stories!
